plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.allOrgs: Plugins are available to every organization of this server. Who may create a data source of a plugin kind is decided by the roles, as for any other data source. Organizations can block a plugin for themselves.
plugins.empty: No plugin is installed yet. “Install from file” checks a package and shows what it asks for before anything runs.
plugins.banner.title: Unsigned plugins are allowed.
plugins.strip.label: Plugins at a glance
plugins.filter.label: Show
plugins.table.label: Installed plugins
plugins.status.stoppedText: It failed too often and waits for a restart.
plugins.permission.settingPort: The host in “{setting}”, port in “{port}”, default {defaultPort} ({protocol})
plugins.sandbox.withoutLandlock: Runs without Landlock on this server.
plugins.install.title: Install from file
plugins.install.lead: For servers without internet and for plugins outside a catalog. The package is checked before anything in it runs.
plugins.install.drop: Drop the package here or choose a file
plugins.install.dropHint: A plugin package (zip) · at most 256 MiB · works without internet
plugins.install.checkingText: The server only checks the package; nothing in it runs. It runs only after you grant its permissions.
plugins.install.invalidHint: Always refused, also when unsigned plugins are allowed. Download the package again from the publisher.
plugins.install.untrustedHint: Check the key’s fingerprint through a second channel, such as the publisher’s website, before you trust it.
plugins.install.platformHint: Ask the publisher for a package for {platform}.
plugins.install.grantsText: Before every call Kalzit checks each target against the target rules of data sources. The sandbox keeps the plugin away from Kalzit’s files, secrets and processes.
plugins.install.changes: Changes against the installed version are marked.
plugins.install.nothingToApprove: The update asks for no new targets and is active now.
plugins.step.signature.invalid: Signature does not match the content
plugins.step.signature.noneText: Unsigned plugins are allowed on this server. Nobody vouches for this package.
plugins.step.checksum.failed: Files do not match the manifest
plugins.step.checksum.text: SHA-256 of every file as the signed manifest lists it, no other files.
plugins.step.update.waitsText: It reaches new targets: {version} keeps running until you approve it.
plugins.catalog.title: The catalog is off
plugins.catalog.lead: The catalog is a signed list of available plugins. Turned on, Kalzit would load it once a day and send only its version and platform. While it is off, Kalzit makes no connection for it.
plugins.catalog.laterText: This Kalzit has no catalog yet. Installing from a file works now, with the same checks.
plugins.trust.keys.title: Trusted keys
plugins.trust.keys.lead: Kalzit loads only plugins whose signature fits one of these keys.
plugins.trust.removeText: Plugins signed with key {keyId} no longer run once it is removed.
plugins.trust.inUse: This key signed installed plugins or waiting updates. Removing it stops them now.
plugins.trust.removedStopped: The key of {name} is removed. Stopped: {plugins}.
plugins.trust.addLead: Trust only keys whose fingerprint you checked through a second channel.
plugins.trust.name: Publisher
plugins.trust.publicKeyHint: As the publisher gives it: base64 or 64 hex digits, also as a PEM block.
plugins.trust.keyInvalid: This is not an Ed25519 public key.
plugins.trust.compare: Compare all 16 characters with the key id the publisher states, for example on their website.
plugins.trust.matchesPackage: Matches the key that signed the refused package.
plugins.trust.differs: This is not the key that signed the refused package ({keyId}).
plugins.trust.unsigned.title: Allow unsigned plugins
plugins.trust.unsigned.lead: Default: off. Only for developing your own plugins on a test server.
plugins.trust.unsigned.riskText: Nobody vouches for an unsigned plugin. Kalzit cannot tell whether it was changed, and it runs with the permissions you grant, including the connection data of its sources. Plugins with an invalid signature always stay refused.
plugins.trust.unsigned.refused: Unsigned plugins are no longer allowed. Those installed keep running.
plugins.trust.landlock.title: Run plugins without Landlock
plugins.trust.landlock.available: This server has Landlock; plugins run with it.
plugins.trust.landlock.missing: This Linux server offers no Landlock. Without this switch, plugins do not start here.
plugins.trust.landlock.riskText: Without Landlock nothing keeps a plugin from reading Kalzit’s files, its database and its keys included.
plugins.risk.scope: This applies to the whole server and every organization.
plugins.risk.unsignedMarked: Every unsigned plugin is marked “Unsigned” in the list.
plugins.risk.unsignedBanner: A band stays on every plugin page until you turn it off again.
plugins.risk.landlockText: Plugins start without the file system sandbox; they can read whatever Kalzit’s account can read.
plugins.risk.audit: The change is recorded in the audit log.
plugins.risk.type: To confirm, type the server’s name:
plugins.risk.mismatch: That is not the server’s name.
plugins.details.approveUpdateText: Version {version} keeps running until you approve. The update is signed with key {signer}.
plugins.details.done.disable: {name} is turned off. Its data sources stay and answer “kind not available”.
plugins.details.done.restart: {name} starts again with the next call.
plugins.details.removeUnused: No data source uses this plugin. Its files and its log are deleted.
plugins.details.removeUsed: {count} data sources in {orgs} organizations use this plugin. They stay with their settings and answer “kind not available” until it is installed again.
plugins.details.secretsText: The connection data of its own sources, only for each call, never stored by the plugin.
plugins.details.filesText: Its package to read and a private temporary folder, emptied with every start.
plugins.details.networkNote: The sandbox does not limit the network yet: Kalzit checks every configured target before each call, and the approval rests on the signature and on what the manifest declares.
plugins.details.notApproved: The plugin does not run before its permissions are approved.
plugins.details.noProcess: No process: the plugin runs only while it is approved, turned on and trusted.
plugins.details.sandboxUnknown: The layers show once the process has started.
plugins.details.usedNone: No data source uses this plugin.
plugins.crash.backoff: Restarts wait 10 s, 30 s, 1, 2, 5 and 10 min; after that the plugin stays stopped until it is restarted by hand.
plugins.log.title: Log
plugins.log.lead: stdout and stderr of the process, the last 2000 lines.
plugins.log.notRunning: The log is empty while the plugin is not loaded.
plugins.log.dropped: {count} lines were dropped because the plugin wrote too fast.
plugins.log.network: Refused connection attempts will appear here once Kalzit holds plugins to their declared targets.
plugins.org.title: Plugins in this organization
plugins.org.lead: Plugins a server admin installed. A plugin turned off here is not offered in “Add data source”, and the sources of its kind answer “kind not available”.
plugins.org.none: No plugin is installed on this server.
plugins.org.unblocked: {name} is offered in this organization again.
